verdict.rationale: Cooley is a law firm offering legal services, free Cooley GO document generators and an internal firm-owned AI company. It is not an automation platform, so versioning, reviewing and rolling back user automations is outside its product category. The evidence about updating S-1 drafts via prompts concerns legal document drafting, not user-managed automations.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
